Required-field regression corpus. Binary fixtures are independently hand-framed form-1 records using the specified FNV-1a field IDs, not output copied from the neutral encoder. `zero` and `populated` are accepted; `missing` refuses `missing_required: b, c`, and `missing-b` refuses `missing_required: b`. Native generated Go checks the same committed pins; the neutral package checks both forms and preserves the expected whole-record refusal.
